prompt: Who broke the short course world record in women's 400m freestyle at the youngest age from 2010 to now?
answer: Ariarne Titmus and Summer McIntosh tied as the youngest, both breaking the women’s 400m freestyle short-course world record at age 18. Li Bingjie was 20 when she broke it in 2022.
